_meta.note: PER is null when net income is not positive. PBR and ROE are null when total equity is not positive. Consolidated (CFS) is used when available, otherwise separate (OFS); the basis column says which. No sector averages are computed.
_meta.howToRead: These are trailing annual multiples, not trailing twelve months. The market cap column is a single trading day (priceAsOf) and the earnings and equity columns come from the annual report for fiscalYear. The gap between those two dates is months, so a company whose earnings moved since its last annual filing will read high or low here. That is why both dates ship as columns: the multiple can be recomputed against any other price date.
_meta.whyRowsAreKept: Rows that could not be computed are kept, with the reason in notMeasured. Dropping them would remove the denominator and leave a flattering count.
